title: perf(console): a record route asks its package list beside the page list
body:
Refs #35455

repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在应用内打开记录页时，控制台现在把「应用对象列表」请求与「页面列表」请求同一轮发出，不再等页面列表回来后才发；列表页不变。
- 为什么改：首屏提速专项第三段。实测记录页的数据请求比列表页多等一轮往返，这一轮正是这个可以并行的等待；托管环境离用户远，每一轮往返都会被放大。
- 风险与回滚：仍是原来的同一个请求，只是提前发出；唯一的代价是对象不在应用导航里、又没有声明记录页时，会多读一次对象列表。直接撤回本 PR 即可恢复原样。
- 先看：ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts（记录路由分支里新增的提前读取及其条件），ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx（按轮计数的新测试）。
- 两分钟验证：pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx -t 35455，预期 5 个测试通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `readAppObjectScope` (app-shell, `console/appObjectScope.ts`), record-route arm: while the page list is out, an app that names a package now starts its package list (`readObjectScope({ packageId })`) in the same commit. Both arms that follow the page list read that list first (a declared page's objects through `readPageObjectScope`, a synthesized page through `readObjectRouteNames`), so it is the same request one round trip earlier, joined by whichever arm runs. The return value while the page list is out is unchanged (`PENDING_OBJECT_SCOPE`, not ready).
- Nothing is started early when the bundle already says it cannot name the record's related objects (`readObjectsReferencing` a miss: no bundle, a draft preview, an object outside the app's navigation), when the app has no package, or at the console root (which passes no readers). The one cost: a bundle still on the wire that then answers a miss, on a record with no declared page, makes that package list a read the whole-registry arm does not use. The code comment says so.
- One changeset (`@object-ui/console`, patch).

No server, spec or contract change, no new endpoint. `main.tsx` boot order, the seed, the auth path and the chunk preload are untouched.

## Tests

- New top-level describe in the existing scope harness `appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx`, "round trips until an app route can render, counted in waves". A wave transport holds every metadata read until the test releases the whole pending set (one round trip) and records what left in each wave until `readAppObjectScope` reports the route ready. This is the hop-count pin.
  - A record route is ready after 2 waves: the app list, then the page list, the package list and the view list together.
  - With the bundle still on the wire, the package list still leaves beside the page list.
  - CONTROL: the object's list route is ready after the same 2 waves.
  - CONTROL: a bundle miss starts no package list beside the page list (wave 2 is the page list alone).
  - CONTROL: an app without a package starts none either.
- Ablation (fix committed first): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the new `readObjectScope({ packageId });` with `void 0;` (anchor x1 to x0, blob 219b3a559b2c to d40fbf7b688a). The two record cells went red with 3 waves (app; page and view; package list) and the three CONTROLs stayed green: Tests 2 failed, 3 passed, 18 skipped. Restore: blob 219b3a559b2c equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../appObjectScope` from source, so no dist rebuild applies.

## Acceptance notes

- Critical path after the shell, from delay probes (hold one response 3 s, see what moves), h2 plus 150 ms emulated latency, cold: list = 3 hops (permissions, organization list and the app list; the app bundle and the package list; data), unchanged. Record = 4 hops before (the package list waited on the page list), 3 after. With the page list held 3 s after the change, the package list still leaves with it and only the data call waits, which it must (it needs to know whether a declared page binds the record).
- Kept dependencies, documented: the app list before the bundle (the URL carries the package id, the bundle is addressed by the app name, and only the app list maps one to the other); the bundle and the package list before data (the data request is built from the object definition); the page list before a record's data (a declared page changes what the page asks).
- The timing-layer metric this card has used (layer = 1 + the deepest layer of any request that ended before it started) is NOT at about 3. To the first data call it reads 4 to 5 after the shell on both pages, 6 to 9 for the whole load. The extra layers come from reads that are not on the data path but end before data starts: the lookup-target presence read (`meta/object?names=sys_user`, it needs the route object's definition), `packages`, the saved-view prefetch, and the console chrome reads (`ai/agents`, approvals, inbox, notification receipts, `i18n/locales`, the user row), which mount after the first-paint readiness gate in `AppContent`. Holding any of them 3 s moves no data call. Between the scope settling and the first data call the client spends about 250 to 450 ms, which is more than one emulated round trip here; on a farther plane fewer of those short reads would finish first. Left on the card: pulling the chrome reads into the boot wave is a prefetch per surface, and the readiness gate is deliberate.
- `me/localization`: 1 per load on every load measured.

## Verification

<details><summary>Readings (objectstack-ai/objectstack, base f44758b21e6, after a3a0adc7ca1; shared box)</summary>

Built console (turbo build of the showcase closure plus `@objectstack/console` build:dist; the after build rebuilt `@object-ui/console` and ran build-dist.sh), `objectstack dev --fresh` from the showcase app on a private port, a local TLS HTTP/2 front, CDP latency 150 ms per request, headless Chromium 1440x900, a new context per load, service workers blocked. cold = cookie only, warm = plus Bearer. n=3 per cell. "to data" = first data call start minus the first post-shell call (`auth/me/permissions`) start, in ms.

| page | posture | api layers | first-data layer | to data ms (median) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| list | cold | 7/6/6 to 6/6/7 | 7/6/6 to 6/6/7 | 906 to 956 |
| record | cold | 8/8/8 to 9/7/8 | 7/7/7 to 6/6/7 | 797 to 644 |
| list | warm | 7/7/7 to 6/7/6 | 6/7/7 to 6/7/6 | 1060 to 821 |
| record | warm | 8/8/10 to 7/7/9 | 7/7/9 to 6/6/9 | 767 to 665 |

The list page's path is unchanged by this diff and is the control: its spread is the box. In every after record load the package list moved from layer 5 to layer 4, beside the page list and the bundle. One warm load per side had two extra pre-shell layers (30 requests), on both sides.

</details>
